summary: End-to-end tested Jewellery Rental CRM (backend + frontend). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering auth (login success/invalid/me with/without token), bookings CRUD (auto bill_no, explicit bill_no, duplicate rejection, search filter, status filter, update persistence, duplicate-bill-no on update, delete + 404), and dashboard stats shape + auth. Frontend: full happy path verified — unauthenticated redirect to /login, invalid creds keep user on /login with error toast, valid login lands on Dashboard with all 7 stat cards rendering INR-formatted values, overdue list populated (BILL-0001), navigation to /bookings, New Booking dialog opens, form submits successfully (auto-generated BILL-0008), row appears in search, Edit dialog opens pre-filled, delete confirm flow removes the row, Sign out clears token and redirects to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, just deprecation noise).

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' combined with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard; fine while frontend uses Bearer token (no cookies), but tighten to explicit origin list for production.
Booking dates are stored as plain ISO strings; lexicographic comparisons in dashboard_stats work only because format is YYYY-MM-DD — keep this invariant documented or switch to typed dates.

next_bill_no uses MongoDB counter but POST /api/bookings is not transactional; in rare race conditions a duplicate bill_no could be attempted — unique index on bill_no will safely reject it, just surface a clearer 409 instead of generic 500 if the insert ever races.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_/PLAY_ prefixed bookings and clean them up via test_zz_cleanup. Pre-existing BILL-0001 (manual) was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_crm_backend.py (pytest, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). All 14 cases pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend Playwright flow covered login (unauth redirect, invalid, valid), dashboard stats render, bookings create/search/edit/delete, and logout. No bugs found; ready for next iteration or feature additions.
